name: Plex Music
author: mfilm
description: Play your own Plex music library from the bar: a turntable with the real album cover on the label, a full-width spectrum analyser in your theme's colours, starred artists, the whole library A-Z, albums and tracks, and your Plex playlists (add to one or start a new one). Keyboard-driven, with a live meter in the bar. Direct play through mpv — no transcode, no Plex Pass, no cloud. Works on the LAN or over a VPN such as Tailscale.

barWidget.description: Shows what is playing from your Plex library; click for the turntable, your starred artists and search.

schema.label: Show the track in the bar
schema.description: Show title and artist next to the icon, not just the icon.

schema.label: Track text width
schema.description: How many characters of "title — artist" to show before it is cut short.

schema.label: Live meter in the bar
schema.description: Show a small spectrum meter beside the track while music is playing.

schema.label: Meter bars
schema.description: How many bars the bar meter has. The panel always shows all 64.
